practice.input: See a café order in progress and hear one complete, natural Korean conversation with two distinct speakers.
practice.output: Say one useful order and answer a small changed-detail prompt in Korean.
practice.dings: One start cue and one end cue around the finished card

card.title: Coffee to Go
card.situation: At a neighborhood café, a customer orders one drink to go and pays by card.
card.description: Order a drink, say it is to go, and pay by card.
card.scene: A customer and a barista speak at a café counter while a card reader is in view.
card.learnerInput: A visible café counter, drink menu, paper cup and card reader; six brief spoken turns in polite everyday Korean.
card.expectedOutput: Order one drink politely, say that it is to go, and answer how to pay.

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.en: No, I'll take it to go.

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.en: Sure. How would you like to pay?

variationPrompt.en: Now order a hot latte to drink at the café. What would you say?
variationPrompt.ko: 이번에는 따뜻한 라테를 매장에서 마실 거예요. 어떻게 말할까요?
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: 따뜻한 라테 한 잔 주세요. 여기서 마실게요.

card.artworkBrief: Warm, contemporary Korean café. A male customer orders at the counter from a female barista; one takeaway paper cup and a card reader establish the physical situation. No visible letters or logos.
